dataset: Roads and Highways - HPMS Off-Highway (OH) Speed Limits (HPMS_OHSpeedLimits)

fields: SpeedLimit (mph); RouteId, FromMeasure, ToMeasure, FromDate, ToDate
updated: updated annually for FHWA HPMS submittal; archiving started 2024-10-15

notes: Also mirrored at gisp.itd.idaho.gov/server/rest/services/GDWarehouse/HPMS/MapServer/11 and RH_General_Service_OTIS/MapServer/44.
